findings.detail: build_physics_player.sh writes -logFile directly into the promotion stage. The resulting sciencebirdsgames/physics-v1/unity-build.log retains [Licensing::Module] channel LicenseClient-<user>, a Unity-masked serial with only the final group replaced by XXXX, and LICENSE SYSTEM lines.
findings.mitigatingContext: The same log is already saturated with absolute /mnt/array/sukaih and /home/sukai paths, so the account identifier is not incrementally revealed by the licensing line. The distinct item is the partially masked serial.

resolution.change: Unity logs into the temporary build root; scripts/redact_unity_log.sh publishes a copy with [Licensing::Module], [LicensingClient], and LICENSE SYSTEM lines replaced in place, failing closed if any survive and renaming atomically.
sideBenefits: published log no longer carries a per-run license timestamp, so it is deterministic
log publication is now an atomic rename, closing the non-atomic wrinkle disclosed in the approved plan
a failed Unity build still publishes its redacted log before propagating the failure
resolution.tests: tests.test_build_physics_player 7/7 pass, including redaction of a real-shaped licensed log, determinism, no temporary residue, and missing-source fail-closed

findings.scope: The log is NOT inside the archive and is NOT part of archive identity; the packager never reads it. Exposure is limited to the untracked stage directory.
findings.title: Published unity-build.log contains Unity licensing lines
